text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Great work, Trainer. Everyone is giving it 
their all out there.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once again, it's nothing grand, but I've 
brought some refreshments, and—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've gone ahead and upgraded the club 
room!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In this more comfortable environment, 
please keep giving it your all toward 
success♪

Thanks to the heartfelt refreshments and 
the club room upgrade, the team's spirits 
soared, and their bonds deepened!
